name: ai.bigredbutton/local-services
title: Big Red Button
description: Find local service providers and open a message draft in your WhatsApp.

tools.name: discover_supply
tools.description: Find existing supply by service and area. Ask only for missing details returned as needs_input. Explicit browse=countries lists A–Z countries and no counts; browse=services or markets supports browsing. No new search.

area.description: City or country the user is looking in, such as Singapore or Cali, Colombia.

browse.description: Choose countries, services, or markets when the user asks to browse. Omit for a specific service lookup.

text.description: Optional place filter for market browsing. For a specific lookup, prefer area.

country.description: Restrict results to a country using its two-letter uppercase code, such as SG for Singapore.

service.description: The local service the user needs, in their own words, such as plumber or aircon repair.

offset.description: For the next page of markets, pass the next_offset returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Read current providers and profiles from a discovered service page. No phone numbers.

service_url.description: Use the Big Red service_url returned by discover_supply for the selected service and area.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: prepare_message
tools.description: Only when the user explicitly asks to message a chosen provider, prepare a Big Red profile link carrying their draft; its Message button uses the normal WhatsApp/referral flow. Present the returned labelled Markdown link directly; never print the raw encoded URL. Keep the reply short. No contact reveal or sending happens until the user clicks Message on the profile.

service_url.description: Use the Big Red service_url returned by discover_supply for the selected service and area.

referral_code.description: Use the exact referral_code returned by list_providers for the provider the user chose.

draft.description: The editable message the user asked to prepare, up to 2,000 characters. Big Red adds its referral separately.
